name: Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi
summary: Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi engages in the insurance business in Turkey. It offers company, accident, illness-health, land vehicles, aircraft, water vehicles, transportation Watercraft, fire and natural disasters, general, land vehicles liability, damages, credit, aircraft liability, general liability, surety, and financial losses, as well as legal protection insurance products. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey. Anadolu Anonim Türk Sigorta Sirketi operates as a subsidiary of Millî Reasürans Türk Anonim Sirketi.
